v1_new_seeds._words: the same settings, five new random seeds: a different roof of the same kind

v2_more_moss._words: a damp roof: a lot more moss than the default, on nearly every slate, more lichen, a softer see-through moss edge

v3_heavily_damaged._words: a neglected roof: deep flaking along every lower edge, cracks, scratches, pits, bites and broken corners

v4_faded_sun_bleached._words: a south-facing roof: long fade, big sun-bleached areas that cross several slates, lighter and greyer slates, little moss

v5_fresh_and_clean._words: a new roof: even tone, no odd-coloured slates, slight paint streaks, almost no damage, no moss

v6_dark_and_wet._words: a roof after rain: darker slates, big damp patches that stay lighter than the joints so every slate outline still reads, a rougher surface, some moss

v7_pale_old._words: an old roof: pale warm-grey slates, flaked edges, lots of lichen, little moss

v8_big_slates._words: a different roof: 6 rows of 4 big slates instead of 8 rows of 6 (all sizes are tile units, so every layer adapts)
